How we grade. Every call names a paper trade priced the day it was added. On the grade date, the call is Right if the trade is worth more than it cost at that day's close, and Wrong otherwise. Nothing else decides the grade. The "Why we hold this view" line explains our reasoning; sometimes it is better to be lucky than good.

Micron
Negative
Long-term view, graded at expiry Dec 15, 2028

Positive
Long-term hold
Five companies making care cheaper and easier to get.
What proves it: HIMS keeps adding subscribers (Q3 at or above 2.891M on Nov 9), TEM and GH keep growing revenue, and GDRX revenue finally moves above its $194–203M range.
Why we hold this view: Five companies making care cheaper and easier to get: online prescriptions (HIMS), drug price discounts (GDRX), AI-driven cancer testing (TEM, GH), and a big diagnostics maker (ABT).
